headline.title: It’s not just one thing — it’s another thing
headline.summary: The phrase construction "It's not just this — it's that" has become a prevalent indicator of AI-generated writing, suggesting a high likelihood that a text is synthetic. This trend highlights the growing recognition of specific linguistic patterns associated with artificial intelligence outputs.

articles.title: Fortnite developers can make AI characters now — just don’t try to date them
articles.summary: Epic Games has introduced a new "conversations" tool for Fortnite creators, allowing them to develop AI-powered characters that players can interact with. This feature aims to enhance gameplay by enabling dynamic dialogues without the need for traditional dialogue trees.

articles.title: NSA spies are reportedly using Anthropic’s Mythos, despite Pentagon feud
articles.summary: The NSA is reportedly utilizing Anthropic's restricted Mythos AI model, despite ongoing tensions with the Pentagon. This development highlights the agency's interest in advanced AI technologies for intelligence purposes.

articles.title: Chinese tech workers are starting to train their AI doubles–and pushing back
articles.summary: Chinese tech workers are facing pressure from employers to train AI agents that could potentially replace them, leading to significant introspection among those who initially embraced AI technology. A recent GitHub project, Colleague Skill, aims to help workers replicate their colleagues' skills and traits, highlighting the growing concern over job security in the tech industry.

articles.title: Prego Has a Dinner-Conversation-Recording Device, Capisce?
articles.summary: Prego has collaborated with the nonprofit StoryCorps to create a device that records family conversations during dinner, preserving these moments for future generations. The initiative aims to encourage meaningful dialogue and connection among family members.

articles.title: CEO and CFO suddenly depart AI nuclear power upstart Fermi
articles.summary: Fermi, an AI nuclear power startup co-founded by former U.S. Energy Secretary Rick Perry, has announced the sudden departure of its CEO and CFO amid challenges at its Texas campus. The company is navigating difficulties in its operations and strategic direction.

articles.title: Autonomous AI at Scale: Adobe Agents Unlock Breakthrough Creative Intelligence With NVIDIA and WPP
articles.summary: Adobe, in collaboration with NVIDIA and WPP, is integrating autonomous AI agents into enterprise marketing operations to enhance creative production and customer experience. This partnership aims to meet the growing demand for personalized customer interactions by leveraging advanced AI technologies.

articles.title: NVIDIA and Partners Showcase the Future of AI-Driven Manufacturing at Hannover Messe 2026
articles.summary: NVIDIA and its partners presented advancements in AI-driven manufacturing at Hannover Messe 2026, highlighting the industry's shift towards more efficient production methods amid pressures for faster design cycles and leaner operations. The focus is now on the speed of AI adoption and its integration into manufacturing processes.

articles.title: Tech CEOs Think AI Will Let Them Be Everywhere at Once
articles.summary: Tech CEOs Mark Zuckerberg and Jack Dorsey are exploring distinct approaches to leveraging AI for management, with both envisioning enhanced control over their operations. Their differing strategies highlight the potential for AI to enable leaders to maintain oversight across various aspects of their businesses simultaneously.

articles.title: OpenAI helps Hyatt advance AI among colleagues
articles.summary: Hyatt has implemented ChatGPT Enterprise, utilizing GPT-5.4 and Codex, to enhance productivity and operations across its global workforce. The initiative aims to improve guest experiences through advanced AI integration.

articles.title: Discover and Prove: An Open-source Agentic Framework for Hard Mode Automated Theorem Proving in Lean 4
articles.summary: The article introduces "Discover and Prove," an open-source framework designed for Hard Mode automated theorem proving in Lean 4, which requires systems to independently discover answers before formal proof construction. This approach aims to provide a more realistic benchmark for evaluating model capabilities compared to the conventional "Easy Mode."

articles.title: The Illusion of Equivalence: Systematic FP16 Divergence in KV-Cached Autoregressive Inference
articles.summary: A recent study highlights that KV caching in autoregressive transformer inference, commonly believed to be numerically equivalent to cache-free computation, actually leads to divergent results when using standard FP16 precision. The research demonstrates that the different floating-point accumulation orderings in cache-ON and cache-OFF paths result in non-associative behavior, affecting the consistency of decoded token sequences across various models.
